description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Notification under the Customs Ordinance (Revenue Protection Order No. 07/2022)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with legal/regulatory matters concerning customs duties and tariff regulations. It contains a parliamentary resolution under the Customs Ordinance that modifies import duty rates, concession lists, and exemption provisions. The document establishes legal frameworks for commodity classification, duty calculation, and preferential treatment systems, making it clearly fall under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure categories or other specialized types.
